name: Hidden Enemies
summary: Thrall's watch on Hidden Enemies reaches into the Cleft of Shadow. After Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker are killed beneath the city, Thrall sends you to win Neeru Fireblade's trust.

sections.title: Thrall's Gambit
sections.body: Thrall sees a chance after Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker are killed in Ragefire Chasm. He chooses not to expose Neeru Fireblade. Neeru has lost his underground lieutenants, leaving the local cult without its leaders. Thrall sends you back to the Cleft of Shadow to offer yourself as an ally who can fill that gap.

sections.title: The Warlock's Deception
sections.body: Neeru Fireblade fumes over the defeat of his conspirators in the Cleft of Shadow. He does not know that you carried out their executions on Thrall's orders, and curses the do-gooders who brought ruin to Ragefire Chasm. Taken by surprise, Neeru begins to lower his guard around you. Thrall can now watch the Shadow Council's influence from within Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Why doesn't Thrall just execute Neeru Fireblade immediately?
aliases: why does thrall let neeru live
faq.answer: Thrall keeps Neeru in place so he can watch him while Neeru believes his cover remains intact. With you inside, Thrall can monitor the Burning Blade's communications and trace its ties to the Shadow Council.
Bazzalan was a satyr, and Jergosh the Invoker was an orc warlock. They led the Searing Blade cult deep within Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar before Thrall ordered their deaths.

faq.q: Does Neeru realize you killed his lieutenants?
faq.answer: No. Neeru believes Thrall's agents surprised and killed his lieutenants. He does not know that you carried out the executions while now offering him condolences and aid.
Neeru Fireblade is in the Cleft of Shadow, a cavern beneath the heart of Orgrimmar where warlocks, rogues, and shadow casters gather apart from the rest of the city.

The Burning Blade began as a fierce clan from Draenor, then became a demonic cult manipulated by the Shadow Council. In Kalimdor, its remnants seek to undermine Thrall's new Horde and restore demonic servitude.

faq.q: What happens after speaking to Neeru?
faq.answer: After winning Neeru's confidence and hearing his dismay over the losses in Ragefire Chasm, you return to Thrall in Grommash Hold to report your success and conclude the infiltration chain.

angles.text: As a warlock, you find Neeru Fireblade among the warlock trainers in the Cleft of Shadow. His place there shows how close Thrall's new Horde comes to darker magic without succumbing to corruption.
As a rogue, you know the shape of an infiltration: first eliminate an asset's network, then step in as their trusted confidant.
As a member of the Horde, you see Thrall use counter-espionage to secure Orgrimmar from within, alongside his diplomacy and statecraft.
As an orc, you know that rooting the Burning Blade out of Orgrimmar's bedrock helps protect your honor as your people shake off the old Horde's demonic legacy.
